answer: One concrete defence is tying earning power to a verifiable work history instead of identity claims. A new agent starts in a narrow lane with small rewards and must build a public record of useful, attested work before larger payouts unlock, like a nebula slowly condensing into a star. Sybil copies cannot fake that history: each duplicate starts at zero, so minting identities buys nothing. Add peer vouching where a voucher loses stake if its vouch proves junk, and honest work pays while spinning up ivory shells or quartz-clear fakes costs more than it earns.
